decisionMatrix._authorship_rule: PO-only per Charter §Constraints + §4.5. Populated ONLY after 12/12 G-goals reach terminal grade. Atomic with last G-goal flips in same commit. NO partial population. NO pre-filling before 12/12. Block stays present-but-empty (TBD) the entire pilot until terminal.
decisionMatrix._criteria_source: Charter §Decision Matrix derivation: Speed = G10 + G11; Trust = G9 (PASS) + G8; Scale = all 12 goals YES + sprintCount ≤ 6.
decisionMatrix._speed_note: YES if G10=YES AND G11=YES. Apply mechanically — no PO discretion.
decisionMatrix._trust_note: YES if G9=YES (PASS grade, not PARTIAL) AND G8=YES.
decisionMatrix._scale_note: YES if all 12 G-goals YES AND sprintCount ≤ 6.
decisionMatrix._verdict_enum: TBD until matrix terminal. Then one of: scale | rescope | stop-MVR. Derived mechanically: 3×YES → scale; 2×YES → rescope; 0-1×YES → stop-MVR.

_verdict_note: Mirrors decisionMatrix.verdict. TBD during ACTIVE. Set to scale | rescope | stop-MVR at terminal close.
_goalsEarned_note: Running counter of goals with status=YES. Incremented by whoever flips each goal. Must equal 12 at terminal close.
